items.title: Billion Dollar Suits
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: Life is rich for these skins in their billion-dollar suits. 12 skins living the dream of modern luxury and style. Dress up for your next billion-dollar deal, royal event, photoshoot, dinner, or a super-secret assignment. Fancy, fame, and fortune, you're just a pack away from becoming the next richest teen in town.

items.title: Nether Worm Village
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
A massive Nether Worm has broken the dimensional barriers and is making its way to the overworld! Start your survival adventure as part of a tribe of Hoglins who have decided to take advantage of the situation and make a new home!

- Keep the slimes at bay.
- Help rebuild your village.
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Kidcore
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Step straight out of wonderland with these colorful and flashy colored skins!
Extremely detailed and very colorful, this skin pack is perfect for almost everything! Try it out with your friends and look adorable!

- 8 cool skins!
- 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Lucky Block - Game Edition
items.creator: Doctor Benx
items.description:
Minecraft is a game among many, imagine you could play all the other games in Minecraft! This Lucky Block makes your dream come true! Equip yourself with the Lucky Block Wall and destroy your opponents' beacons! Last one standing wins!
-New craftable armor + weapons
-Epic PvP-battle in bedwars-like game mode
-100+ drops
-Custom armor effects
-2-4 players
-By Benx + oectway

items.title: Pastel Rainbows
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Cute and colorful, these skins will be an adorable edition to your rainbow collection! Dress up in rainbows and have a wonderful day!

- 13 rainbow skins

items.title: Pretty Pattern Party
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Everyone loves patterns, shapes and colors and these skins have it all! Become a beautiful pattern with one of these many designs to choose from!

- 10 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Among Galaxies 3
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Travel space in your new spacesuits! There are so many colors to choose from! Now you and your friends can roleplay as astronauts!

- 10 astronaut skins

items.title: BriannaPlayz Boy vs Girl Teens
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Pick your skin and team up with Brianna! Colorful pink versus vibrant blue skins. A total of 24 skins ready for PvP or roleplay. 

- 1 free Brianna skin
- 24 total skins

items.title: Space Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Space is no longer safe from these dangerous mobs! With brand new space suits, they're ready for take off!

- 8 astronaut mob skins!

Set includes:

- Creeper
- Piglin
- Skeleton
- Slime
- Spider
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Ghast

items.title: Rainbow Camo
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Take your love of camo and rainbows and put them together! Look adorable in these bright-colored neon camo skins! With colors spanning the entire rainbow, there's sure to be in a skin in here for you!

+ Unique theme with bright colors!
+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!

items.title: Cartoon Planes
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Take flight in with these vibrant cartoon styled planes all across the skies! Complete tasks for rewards while getting your license to fly around the town as well as in the world in one of the unique 8 planes. Complete the heist events to earn upgrades through upgrade points and items in order to enhance your plane!

items.title: Element Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
The Element Teens have arrived, dominating different elements, their powers are impressive! What are you waiting to acquire these amazing skins?

+11 Different Element Teens
+1 free skin
by UnderBlocks

items.title: Pajama Party
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
It's time for a pajama party! Go through the night telling funny stories, play around, or just travel in your comfy PJs!
Walk proudly in your very own colorful and comfortable slumber wear!

- 8 cute pajama skins!
+ Includes all kinds of styles!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Birds and the Bees
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Fly high in the sky, soaring to the cliffs as a beautiful bird, like the endangered macaw or the majestic eagle. You can also flutter closer to the ground, smelling all of the lovely spring flowers as a bee, wasp or yellow jacket. Which ever you decide, you will become one with nature. 

- 12 skins
- Become a swan for free

items.title: Anime Academia
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Have you always wanted to be an anime character?
This teen skin pack contains all the characters you need to be a real superstar! Jump straight out of a series being all cute and adorable, or scary and intimidating!

+ 8 awesome skins!
+ 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Fashion Teens 2021
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Catch up on the latest fashion trends and be part of the crew! Don't be left behind, join your teen friends and hang out in the city with the newest trends! Make the best of 2021!

- 20 trendy skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Endermen In Suits
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Looking cool in these Endermen in suits. Style up with your friends and walk around looking smart.

- 10 skins
- Includes 1 free skin

items.title: Mobs Wearing Suits
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Strut around as a mob in a suit. Choose your favourite mob and show off to your friends.

- 12 mobs in suits
- Includes 1 free skin

items.title: Anime: Zero to Hero
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description:
This skin pack will teleport you to a whole new world! Play as one of the four anime protagonists to explore the realm you now find yourself in! Level up from regular anime teen to pro adventurer! There are so many classes to play as, from ninja to witch! Or perhaps you would like to play as the evil time lord? 

You decide, with this anime roleplay skin pack!

items.title: Climb!
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Climb! Have you got what it takes to climb to the top & defeat the Ender Dragon?

A challenging unique twist on the classic skyblock genre, climbing higher will give you access to more blocks to help you survive but you will also face more danger. 

- Skyblock, with a twist
- Challenging
- Custom traders
- Lucky Blocks!
- Created by DanRobzProbz

items.title: SQUAD!
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Squad assemble! It's time to pick out a stylish outfit, and show it off to all of your friends!

+ 12 teenage skins
+ Cool grey outfits

items.title: Waffles
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Did someone say waffles? Dress as one of these crazy waffles, ranging from astronauts to zombies to scuba divers!

+ 7 wild waffle skins
+ Super random outfits

items.title: Robo Mobs
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Why dress up as a regular mob when you can dress up as a robot mob?

+ 8 HD robot mob outfits
+ Cartoony design

items.title: BLING! SD
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
With the coolest of clothes and goldest of jewelry, these skins are certain to make you stand out!

+ 12 standard definition teenage skins
+ The most trendy clothing
+ Lots of golden jewelry
